-        find . -type f -name '*.zo' -delete
-        find . -depth -type d -name compiled -exec rm -rf {} +
+        # The frozen discovery fixture (tests/metadata-discovery/fixture/)
+        # keeps a TRACKED stray .rkt inside a compiled/ directory as pinned

+        find . -depth -type d -name compiled -not -path './tests/metadata-discovery/fixture/*' -exec rm -rf {} +
